commands:
cd /w && echo "observed docker binary: $(command -v docker || echo none)"; python3 - <<'EOF'
import re,json,urllib.request
ok=True
for f in ['Dockerfile.cpu','Dockerfile.gpu']:
    m=re.search(r'^FROM\s+(\S+)',open(f).read(),re.M)
    base=m.group(1); repo,_,tag=base.partition(':'); tag=tag or 'latest'
    if '/' not in repo: repo='library/'+repo
    url=f'https://hub.docker.com/v2/repositories/{repo}/tags/{tag}'
    try:
        r=urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'probe'}),timeout=20); st=r.status; body=r.read().decode()[:120]
    except Exception as e:
        st=getattr(e,'code',str(e)); body=''
    print(f'observed {f}: FROM {base} -> hub tag lookup status {st} {body!r}')
    ok = ok and st==200
import shutil
if not ok:
    print('VERDICT_LINE: FAIL Dockerfile base image tag no longer resolvable on Docker Hub, docker build cannot succeed')
elif shutil.which('docker') is None:
    print('VERDICT_LINE: PASS Dockerfile.cpu/.gpu exist and their tensorflow base tags still resolve on Docker Hub (build itself not executed: no docker daemon in probe container)')
else:
    print('VERDICT_LINE: PASS Dockerfiles exist and base tags resolve; run docker build in a docker-capable runner to confirm')
EOF

commands:
cd /w && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json,urllib.request,re
docs=open('download_model.py').read()+open('DEVELOPERS.md').read()+open('README.md').read()
print('observed doc mentions: 124M' , '124M' in docs, '355M', '355M' in docs, '117M', '117M' in docs, '345M', '345M' in docs)
assert '124M' in docs and '355M' in docs
def params(h):
    L,E,V,C=h['n_layer'],h['n_embd'],h['n_vocab'],h['n_ctx']
    return L*(12*E*E+13*E)+V*E+C*E+2*E
res={}
for name in ['124M','355M']:
    url=f'https://openaipublic.blob.core.windows.net/gpt-2/models/{name}/hparams.json'
    r=urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'probe'}),timeout=20)
    h=json.load(r); n=params(h); res[name]=n
    print(f'observed {name}: status {r.status} hparams {h} -> computed params {n/1e6:.1f}M')
assert abs(res['124M']/1e6-124)<2 and abs(res['124M']/1e6-117)>5, res
assert abs(res['355M']/1e6-355)<2 and abs(res['355M']/1e6-345)>5, res
print('VERDICT_LINE: PASS checkpoints named 124M/355M exist and their hparams compute to ~124M/~355M params, not 117M/345M')
EOF
